name: structFilter
description: This function creates a new Struct that returns all entries from an struct that match the given filter.
syntax: structFilter( struct struct, function filter, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: filter
params.description:
A function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(any key, any value) { return true/false; }`

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
